messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The system incorrectly merges or displays joint policyholder names, often showing only one name or the wrong one.
  quote: when there are joint policyholder names, the system merges them incorrectly—sometimes only showing one or the wrong one, and it’s causing real issues with policyholders.
- problem: The system is incorrectly handling or displaying joint policyholder names in outgoing letters.
  quote: we’ve been having some trouble with joint policyholder names in outgoing letters.
- problem: The system fails to display both names for joint policyholders, showing only one instead.
  quote: the system isn’t merging both names correctly — it’s only showing one joint policyholder names
- problem: Letters sent to joint policyholders incorrectly display only one name instead of both.
  quote: We’re seeing repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display one name — this leads to complaints and we need the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in all communications.
- problem: The system generates letters with mismatched names for joint policyholder cases, leading to customer complaints.
  quote: We’ve got a few joint policyholder cases where the letters are coming out with mismatched names—causing complaints.
- problem: The letter generation feature incorrectly merges multiple names, displaying only one name or the wrong name, which damages client trust.
  quote: The issue with letters merging multiple names on letters is causing us real problems — clients are complaining because only one name shows up, and sometimes it’s not even the right one.
- problem: The system fails to display all names on letters sent to joint policyholders, showing only one name instead.
  quote: letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing real friction with clients.
- problem: The system incorrectly populates only one name, often the wrong one, on letters for policies with two named holders.
  quote: when letters go out for policies with two named holders, the system only includes one name — and sometimes it’s the wrong one... led to some frustrated calls from policyholders and extra work for our team to fix the letters manually.
